sql.ahj.utility.list.all: SELECT u.id, u.name, u.metro_area_id, lov.name as metro_area, cs.id as company_state_id, cs.state_id, s.state, s.abbreviation as state_abbreviation, u.archived FROM brs.ahj_utility u LEFT JOIN flow.list_of_value lov ON lov.id = u.metro_area_id left join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = u.company_state_id left join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id ORDER BY u.name
sql.ahj.utility.simple.update: UPDATE brs.ahj_utility SET name = :utilityName, archived = :archived, metro_area_id = :metroAreaId, company_state_id = :companyStateId, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.utility.update: UPDATE brs.ahj_utility SET name = :utilityName, archived = :archived, metro_area_id = :metroAreaId, company_state_id = :companyStateId, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser, timelines_and_stages = :timelinesAndStages, regulated_by = :regulatedBy, monthly_facility_charge = :monthlyFacilityCharge, population_of_service = :populationOfService, net_metering_rate = :netMeteringRate, rebate_rates = :rebateRates, utility_rate_notes = :utilityRateNotes, customer_signature_instructions = :customerSignatureInstructions, expected_approval_timeline = :expectedApprovalTimeline, rejection_instructions = :rejectionInstructions, notes = :notes, overview_of_submission_process = :overviewOfSubmissionProcess, submission_instructions = :submissionInstructions, timelines = :timelines, pto_followup_instructions = :ptoFollowupInstructions, final_completion_instructions = :finalCompletionInstructions, financier_id = :financierId WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.utility.insert: INSERT INTO brs.ahj_utility(name, archived, date_created, created_by_id, metro_area_id, company_state_id) VALUES (:utilityName, false, now(), :currentUser, :metroAreaId, :companyStateId)
sql.ahj.utility.detailById: SELECT u.*, f.name AS "financier", lov.name as metro_area, cs.state_id, s.state, s.abbreviation, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(contacts))) FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.title, c.email, c.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", c.address, c.notes, c.hours FROM brs.ahj_contact c INNER JOIN brs.ahj_utility_contact auc ON c.id = auc.ahj_contact_id WHERE auc.ahj_utility_id = u.id AND c.archived IS FALSE AND c.contact_type_id = 8 ) contacts), '[]') AS contacts, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_utility_checklist auc ON ac.id = auc.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND ac.checklist_type_id = 4 AND auc.ahj_utility_id = u.id ORDER BY ac.display_order ) checklist), '[]') AS submission_checklist, coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_utility_checklist auc ON ac.id = auc.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND ac.checklist_type_id = 5 AND auc.ahj_utility_id = u.id ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]') AS approval_checklist, coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_utility_checklist auc ON ac.id = auc.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND ac.checklist_type_id = 6 AND auc.ahj_utility_id = u.id ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]') AS pto_checklist, coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_utility_checklist auc ON ac.id = auc.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND ac.checklist_type_id = 7 AND auc.ahj_utility_id = u.id ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]') AS utility_inspection_checklist, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT aul.id, aul.name, aul.link, aul.username, aul.link_type_id AS "linkTypeId", aul.password, aul.notes FROM brs.ahj_utility_link aul WHERE aul.archived IS FALSE AND aul.link_type_id = 6 AND aul.ahj_utility_id = u.id) links ), '[]') AS customer_signature_links, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT aul.id, aul.name, aul.link, aul.username, aul.link_type_id AS "linkTypeId", aul.password, aul.notes FROM brs.ahj_utility_link aul WHERE aul.archived IS FALSE AND aul.link_type_id = 7 AND aul.ahj_utility_id = u.id) links ), '[]') AS pto_links, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT aul.id, aul.name, aul.link, aul.username, aul.link_type_id AS "linkTypeId", aul.password, aul.notes FROM brs.ahj_utility_link aul WHERE aul.archived IS FALSE AND aul.link_type_id = 8 AND aul.ahj_utility_id = u.id) links ), '[]') AS pto_followup_links, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT aul.id, aul.name, aul.link, aul.username, aul.link_type_id AS "linkTypeId", aul.password, aul.notes FROM brs.ahj_utility_link aul WHERE aul.archived IS FALSE AND aul.link_type_id = 9 AND aul.ahj_utility_id = u.id) links ), '[]') AS submission_links, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(requirements))) FROM ( WITH open_challenge AS ( SELECT utility_id, original_requirement_id, status_id FROM brs.ahj_utility_requirements ar WHERE status_id = 3 ) SELECT aur.utility_id AS "utilityId", aur.position, aur.status_id AS "statusId", ars.name status, aur.complete, aur.date_created AS "dateCreated", aur.created_by_id AS "createdById", concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS "createdBy", aur.date_modified AS "dateModified", aur.modified_by_id AS "modifiedById", concat(u2.first_name, ' ', u2.last_name) AS "modifiedBy", ar.id, ar.description, ar.requirement_type_id AS "requirementTypeId", aur.original_requirement_id AS "originalRequirementId", CASE WHEN oc.original_requirement_id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS "hasOpenChallenge" FROM brs.ahj_utility_requirements aur LEFT JOIN open_challenge oc ON oc.utility_id = aur.utility_id AND oc.original_requirement_id = aur.original_requirement_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_requirement ar ON ar.id = aur.requirement_id INNER JOIN flow."user" u ON u.id = aur.created_by_id INNER JOIN flow."user" u2 ON u2.id = aur.modified_by_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_requirement_status ars ON ars.id = aur.status_id WHERE aur.utility_id = :id AND aur.status_id = 1 AND aur.archived IS NOT TRUE AND ars.archived IS NOT TRUE ORDER BY aur.position) requirements ), '[]') AS utility_requirements FROM brs.ahj_utility u LEFT JOIN flow.list_of_value lov ON lov.id = u.metro_area_id left join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = u.company_state_id left join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id LEFT JOIN brs.financier f ON f.id = u.financier_id WHERE u.id = :id
sql.ahj.utility.contact.add: WITH auc AS ( insert into brs.ahj_contact (name, title, email, phone_number, address, notes, hours, date_created, created_by_id, date_modified, modified_by_id, contact_type_id) values (:name, :title, :email, :phoneNumber, :address, :notes, :hours, now(), :currentUser, now(), :currentUser, :contactTypeId) returning id ) INSERT INTO brs.ahj_utility_contact (ahj_utility_id, ahj_contact_id) SELECT :ahjUtilityId, auc.id FROM auc RETURNING ahj_contact_id;
sql.ahj.utility.contact.update: UPDATE brs.ahj_contact SET name = :name, title = :title, email = :email, phone_number = :phoneNumber, address = :address, notes = :notes, hours = :hours, modified_by_id = :currentUser, date_modified = now() WHERE id = :contactId
sql.ahj.utility.contact.delete: UPDATE brs.ahj_contact SET archived = TRUE, modified_by_id = :currentUser, date_modified = now() WHERE id = :contactId
sql.ahj.utility.checklist.add: WITH auc AS ( insert into brs.ahj_checklist (description, display_order, date_created, created_by_id, date_modified, modified_by_id, checklist_type_id, failed_inspection_resource_id, failed_inspection_date, failed_inspection_project) values (:description, :displayOrder, now(), :currentUser, now(), :currentUser, :checklistTypeId, :failedInspectionResourceId, :failedInspectionDate, :failedInspectionProject) returning id ) INSERT INTO brs.ahj_utility_checklist (ahj_utility_id, ahj_checklist_id) SELECT :ahjUtilityId, auc.id FROM auc RETURNING ahj_checklist_id;
sql.ahj.utility.checklist.update: UPDATE brs.ahj_checklist SET description = :description, display_order = :displayOrder, modified_by_id = :currentUser, date_modified = now(), checklist_type_id = :checklistTypeId, failed_inspection_resource_id = :failedInspectionResourceId, failed_inspection_date = :failedInspectionDate, failed_inspection_project = :failedInspectionProject WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.utility.checklist.delete: UPDATE brs.ahj_checklist SET archived = TRUE, modified_by_id = :currentUser, date_modified = now() WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.utility.link.update: UPDATE brs.ahj_utility_link SET ahj_utility_id = :ahjUtilityId, name = :name, link = :link, username = :username, password = :password, notes = :notes, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.utility.link.delete: UPDATE brs.ahj_utility_link SET archived = true, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.utility.requirement.history: SELECT ar.requirement_type_id, ars.utility_id, ars.requirement_id id, ars.original_requirement_id, ar.description, ars."position", ars.status_id, arst.name AS status, ars.complete, ars.date_created, ars.created_by_id, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS "createdBy", ars.date_modified, concat(u2.first_name, ' ', u2.last_name) AS "modifiedBy", ars.modified_by_id FROM brs.ahj_utility_requirements ars JOIN brs.ahj_requirement ar ON ar.id = ars.requirement_id JOIN brs.ahj_requirement_status arst ON arst.id = ars.status_id INNER JOIN flow."user" u on u.id = ars.created_by_id INNER JOIN flow."user" u2 on u2.id = ars.modified_by_id WHERE ars.original_requirement_id = :originalRequirementId AND ars.utility_id = :utilityId ORDER BY arst.display_order, ars.date_created DESC
sql.ahj.utility.requirement.add: WITH ar AS ( INSERT INTO brs.ahj_requirement (requirement_type_id, description, date_created, created_by_id, date_modified, modified_by_id) VALUES (:requirementTypeId, :description, now(), :createdById, now(), :modifiedById) RETURNING id ) INSERT INTO brs.ahj_utility_requirements (utility_id, requirement_id, position, status_id, date_created, created_by_id, date_modified, modified_by_id, original_requirement_id) SELECT :utilityId, ar.id, :position, :statusId, now(), :createdById, now(), :modifiedById, ar.id FROM ar RETURNING original_requirement_id;
sql.ahj.utility.requirement.active.detail: WITH open_challenge AS ( SELECT utility_id, original_requirement_id, status_id FROM brs.ahj_utility_requirements ar WHERE status_id = 3 ) SELECT aur.utility_id, aur.position, aur.status_id, ars.name status, aur.complete, aur.date_created, aur.created_by_id, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) createdBy, aur.date_modified, aur.modified_by_id, concat(u2.first_name, ' ', u2.last_name) modifiedBy, ar.id, ar.description, ar.requirement_type_id, aur.original_requirement_id, (case when oc.original_requirement_id is not null then true else false end) has_open_challenge FROM brs.ahj_utility_requirements aur LEFT JOIN open_challenge oc ON oc.utility_id = aur.utility_id AND oc.original_requirement_id = aur.original_requirement_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_requirement ar ON ar.id = aur.requirement_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_requirement_type art ON art.id = ar.requirement_type_id INNER JOIN flow."user" u ON u.id = aur.created_by_id INNER JOIN flow."user" u2 ON u2.id = aur.modified_by_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_requirement_status ars ON ars.id = aur.status_id WHERE aur.utility_id = :utilityId AND aur.original_requirement_id = :originalRequirementId AND aur.status_id = 1 AND aur.archived IS NOT TRUE
sql.ahj.utility.requirement.archive:
UPDATE brs.ahj_utility_requirements SET archived = true, status_id = 2, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById WHERE original_requirement_id = :originalRequirementId;
UPDATE brs.ahj_requirement SET archived = true, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById WHERE id IN (select requirement_id from brs.ahj_utility_requirements where original_requirement_id = :originalRequirementId);
